records.text: Rhonin leads the Kirin Tor in Dalaran and insists that a reported invasion at the Violet Hold be handled discreetly to avoid alarming citizens. Pressing business keeps Rhonin in the city, so helpers are sent to old friend Krasus after news of an attack on the Ruby Sanctum. In a public address celebrating allies' defeat of Algalon at Ulduar, Rhonin argues that free will and the worth of mortal lives defy the cold logic that judged their world expendable.

Lan'dalock serves the Kirin Tor's strategic interests and coordinates its weekly raid assignments. The missions frame targets as threats to the magocracy, from Scourge research at Naxxramas to Malygos draining the world's magic and the Legion risk at the Trial of the Crusader; each is presented as a Council of Six decree.

Archmage Pentarus offered to help fund Hemet Nesingwary's Sholazar expedition, expecting samples of exotic plants, reagents and crystals. With no word from Hemet or supply runner Monte Muzzleshot, he offers his flying machine to investigators. He also enjoys battle ball with fellow mages, preparing a mustard-dog picnic and hoping the Dalaran Destroyers will finally win.
Aludane Whitecloud is the flight master at Dalaran’s Krasus’ Landing. His flight service offers travelers a way to make a quick journey.
Teller Rames is a banker in Crystalsong Forest. He provides access to banking for travelers who want to manage their stored belongings.
Teller Althiellis is a banker in Crystalsong Forest. She provides access to banking for travelers who want to manage their stored belongings.
Teller Hanners is a banker who provides visitors with access to their bank. His role is focused on this practical service for people who need to manage their belongings while in the area.

Inzi Charmlight is a barmaid who also sells goods. She moves along a route through her workplace, pausing at several points along the way; her duties combine customer service with a steady routine around the lounge.

Narisa Redgold is a barmaid who offers goods for visitors to browse. Her work brings together the familiar hospitality of bar service and the practical help of a vendor, giving her a place in the everyday life of the local inn.

Caliel Brightwillow is an assistant innkeeper who offers travelers the option to make the inn their home. The role connects Caliel with the everyday hospitality of the inn, helping visitors establish a place to return to during their travels.

Amisi Azuregaze is the innkeeper of the Legerdemain Lounge, greeting visitors with a wish that they enjoy their stay. Amisi's work also includes practical guest services: visitors can ask to make the inn their home or browse goods.

Tassia Whisperglen is a stable master whose work centers on travelers' animal companions. Tassia offers pet stabling and assistance with lost companions, providing practical help to people who rely on their animals during their travels.
Susana Averoy runs a general-goods counter, with wares available to browse. Her name and shop specialty distinguish her from the nearby trade-supplies seller, Red Jack Findle.
Known as “Red” Jack Findle, this vendor deals in trade supplies.
Enchanter Nalthanis is identified as a Grand Master Enchanting Trainer. Nalthanis offers training.
Alard Schmied is identified as a Grand Master Blacksmithing Trainer. Alard offers training.
Derik Marks is identified as a Grand Master Skinning Trainer. Derik offers training.
Timofey Oshenko is identified as a Grand Master Engineering Trainer. Timofey offers training.
Jedidiah Handers is a grand master mining trainer in Dalaran.
Charles Worth is a grand master tailoring trainer in Dalaran. He teaches Cloth Scavenging, which can yield extra Frostweave from slain humanoids, and knows the Wispcloak and Deathchill Cloak recipes.
Diane Cannings is a grand master leatherworking trainer in Dalaran.

Timothy Jones is a grand master jewelcrafting trainer in Dalaran who also handles crafted-jewelry shipments for an Undermine concern. His attributed replies request particular shipment pieces and promise Jewelcrafter's Tokens, with further requests expected; he also recalls that necklaces were looted from one of his shipments weeks earlier.
Professor Pallin is a named Grand Master Inscription Trainer, specializing in advanced inscription instruction.

Linzy Blackbolt is a Grand Master Alchemy Trainer. Her Cardinal Ruby lesson asks an alchemist to complete five epic-gem transmutes as preparation before she teaches the recipe; several gem types count, and the same transmute may be repeated. Her response explains that the recipe depends on aligning the facets.
Dorothy Egan is a named Grand Master Herbalism Trainer, specializing in advanced herbalism instruction.

Katherine Lee is a Grand Master Cooking Trainer; her kitchen dialogue describes preparing some of Dalaran's finest food. Her cooking assignments serve local customers and visitors: she requests a meatloaf for Orton Bennet, stew for sewer innkeeper Ajay Green, and a picnic basket for Archmage Pentarus.

Olisarra the Kind is a Grand Master First Aid trainer in Dalaran. She is the person to bring a prison guard’s recovered arm to, as the clinic may be able to reattach it. She says Marcia told her the player would arrive with the arm, remarks on the reward bag’s smell, and is eager to complete the exchange.
Angelo Pescatore supplies fishing goods in Crystalsong Forest. Visitors can browse his goods.

Kizi Copperclip is a Dalaran barber. The barbershop greeting welcomes customers and advertises grooming, piercings, tattoos, and changes to features such as horns and tendrils, presenting the service as a way to leave with a new look.
Ildine Sorrowspear is a Dalaran supplier of enchanting goods. She offers help finding items and gives brief welcomes and greetings.
Endora Moorehead is a Dalaran vendor of magical goods. Her recorded lines welcome visitors, invite them to look around, and offer help finding items; the supplied speech is routine service talk.
Palja Amboss supplies blacksmithing goods and offers repair services.

Ranid Glowergold supplies leatherworking and skinning goods at the Leatherworkers shop in Dalaran’s Magus Commerce Exchange. He has a sudden craving for wine and cheese and is quite peckish while waiting for a platter; his greetings otherwise welcome customers and offer help finding goods.
Tiffany Cartier supplies jewelcrafting goods. Her greetings welcome customers and offer help finding items.
Bryan Landers supplies engineering goods and offers repair services.
Larana Drome supplies inscription goods and reagents. Her greetings welcome customers and offer help finding items.
Patricia Egan sells alchemy supplies and welcomes visitors to browse. Her greetings are brief and courteous, fitting a shopkeeper who is ready to help customers find what they need.

Dominique Stefano supplies tailoring goods and welcomes visitors to browse. The greetings are brief and courteous, presenting a helpful shopkeeper ready to assist customers looking for tailoring supplies.
Edward Egan supplies herbalism goods and welcomes visitors to browse. His greetings are brief and courteous, presenting a helpful shopkeeper ready to assist customers looking for herbalism supplies.
Dorian Fines is the named mining-supplies vendor, with goods available for visitors to browse.

Marcia Chase is Dalaran’s Grand Master fishing trainer, an adventurous angler with an eye for unusual catches. She knows the sewers for discarded jewelry, blood pools for bloodtooth, and the ghostfish of Sholazar. She is willing to trade for curious finds, wonders at the ghostfish’s vanishing trick, and regales visitors with fishing adventures.
Andrew Matthews is Dalaran’s Guild Master at the Guild Registry offices. The registry menu associated with him covers creating a guild crest and learning how to form a guild.
Elizabeth Ross is Dalaran’s tabard vendor. She handles inquiries about lost Blood Knight, Hand, Protector and Green Trophy Illidari tabards.
Breanni supplies pet goods in Crystalsong Forest and warmly invites visitors to browse.
Warcaster Fanoraithe is a mage trainer who welcomes mages and warns that magic can burn the untrained.
Jessa Weaver is a mage trainer who welcomes mages and warns that magic can burn the untrained.
Aemara is a bowyer. Her greetings welcome visitors and offer help finding goods.
Anthony Durain is a shield merchant.
Valaden Silverblade is a sword merchant.
Valerie Langrom is a leather armor merchant.
Aerith Primrose is a flower vendor in Crystalsong Forest, inviting visitors to browse her goods.
Abra Cadabra is a wand merchant in Dalaran who greets shoppers and offers help finding goods.
Paldesse is a cloth armor merchant in Crystalsong Forest.
Griselda Hunderland is a plate armor merchant in Crystalsong Forest who greets shoppers and offers help finding goods.

Arille Azuregaze tends the Legerdemain Lounge bar in Dalaran. With a convention approaching, Arille urgently asks after the food and says the guests should find the meal acceptable, though it came from Awilo.

Archmage Celindra is a portal trainer at Dalaran’s Violet Gate. She explains the crystals linking the city with the ruins below and discusses portal magic, including teaching a return portal to mages she considers ready.

Silver Covenant Guardian Mages are posted around Dalaran, including the Violet Gate and nearby districts. Their name identifies their faction and mage role; this entry represents the Silver Covenant side of the shared guardian-mage presence.

Sunreaver Guardian Mages are posted around Dalaran, including the Violet Gate and nearby districts. Their name identifies their faction and mage role; this entry represents the Sunreaver side of the shared guardian-mage presence.
Windle Sparkshine is a named goods vendor in Dalaran. He can follow a route.
Paymaster Alstein is a banker in Crystalsong Forest who provides access to a customer’s bank.
Torgo the Younger is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Dagna Flintlock is a gunsmith who offers goods and repairs.
Jepetto Joybuzz is a toymaker. His Wonderworks greeting describes toys for people young and old and invites them to browse.
Karandonna is a clothier who greets customers and offers help finding something. Her greetings range from a simple welcome to an invitation to look around, including a class-specific greeting.
Jarold Puller specializes in ammunition and offers goods and repairs.
Shen Kang Cheng is a staff specialist who offers goods and repairs.
Norvin Alderman is a cloak specialist who offers goods.
Kerta the Bold is an axe and polearm merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Walther Whiteford is a mace merchant who offers goods for browsing. His trade centers on maces, giving this named vendor a clear weapon specialty.
Bartram Haller is a dagger and fist weapon merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Imindril Spearsong trains weaponsmithing, helping aspiring smiths learn the profession and develop their craft.
Orland Schaeffer welcomes travelers and trains armorsmithing, helping smiths learn the profession and develop their craft.
Manfred Staller trains Elemental Leatherworking, helping aspiring leatherworkers learn this specialization and develop their craft.
Andellion is identified as a Dragonscale Leatherworking Trainer.
Namha Moonwater is identified as a Tribal Leatherworking Trainer.
Linna Bruder is the Shadoweave Tailoring Specialist, and her vendor service offers goods for browsing.
Lalla Brightweave is the Spellfire Tailoring Specialist, and her vendor service offers goods for browsing.
Ainderu Summerleaf is the Mooncloth Tailoring Specialist, and the vendor service offers goods for browsing.
Didi the Wrench is identified as a Goblin Engineering Trainer.
Findle Whistlesteam is identified as a Gnome Engineering Trainer.

Bragund Brightlink is a Mail Armor Merchant who welcomes visitors with several brief greetings and offers help finding something. His shop lines are courteous and practical, including an invitation to browse and an offer to help locate goods.

Orton Bennet runs a shop and says he rarely gets away from it. His quest replies show a personal concern about food: he asks whether food is for him, wonders if it came from Awilo, and asks for assurance that it contains no gnome. The lines suggest food matters to him.
Debbi Moore is the vendor at Trinkets & Charms in Dalaran. Visitors can browse her goods.
Ninsianna is associated with the Relics shop. Visitors can browse her goods.
Binzik Goldbook is identified as a banker. Visitors can open their bank with him.

Ajay Green is the innkeeper of Dalaran's sewers, where hungry patrons depend on stew deliveries. At the Cantrips and Crows Tavern he warns visitors to watch their backs, noting that Narisa dislikes scrubbing blood from the floor.
Schembari “Uncle Sal” Shearbolt is an Arena Battlemaster.
“Baroness” Llana is an Arena Organizer.

Alchemist Cinesra is a poison vendor who handles dangerous substances. When presented with an exceptionally potent venom, she recognizes its danger and says she can always use venom of that strength, showing a practical interest in potent poisons.
Darahir deals in reagents and magical goods, serving customers looking for magical supplies.
Hexil Garrot sells tools of the trade and also repairs equipment, pairing his wares with a practical repair service.
Applebough is a fruit vendor in Dalaran, with a straightforward role: he offers fruit for visitors to browse.
Aimee sells pies, pastries, and cakes in Dalaran. Her named specialty sets her apart from the other vendors nearby.
"Techs" Rickard Rustbolt is an Arena Battlemaster.
Angelique Butler is a first-aid supplies vendor in Dalaran. Her shop serves that specific practical need, distinguishing her from the city's food and other goods sellers.

Awilo Lon'gomba is a grand master cooking trainer in Dalaran. His cooking work reaches other local businesses through food deliveries, and his dialogue is irreverent: he jokes that the Horde outlawed cannibalism and wishes he could serve his gnome specialty.
Hagatha Moorehead is a reagent merchant in Dalaran, serving visitors who need reagents.
Josie Birch is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Theresa Wolf is a Loremaster associated with the area where she appears.
High Arcanist Savor presents himself as a master of the Arcane and boasts of leaving corpses ablaze. His words project confidence and menace toward challengers.
Grand Marauder Sai speaks of a life marked by hardship and conflict with the Horde, and says the rage of battle remains in his heart.
Pazik “The Pick” Prylock is a locksmith who offers help to people who have lost keys. His conversation topics concern keys to Scholomance, The Arcatraz, The Shattered Halls, and Searing Gorge.
Warsong Gulch Portal is a portal to the Warsong Gulch battleground.
A battleground portal identified with Arathi Basin.
A battleground portal identified with Alterac Valley.
A battleground portal identified with the Eye of the Storm.

A Strand of the Ancients battleground portal. Its associated greeting mentions that a visitor is not yet strong enough to do battle there, though the conditions governing that message are unspecified.
A battleground portal identified with Warsong Gulch.
A battleground portal identified with Arathi Basin.
A battleground portal identified with Alterac Valley.
A battleground portal identified with the Eye of the Storm.

A Strand of the Ancients battleground portal. Its associated greeting mentions that a visitor is not yet strong enough to do battle there, though the conditions governing that message are unspecified.
Chameli Banaphash is a haberdasher in Dalaran, where she offers goods to browse.
Sheddle Glossgleam is Dalaran’s cobbler and shoeshiner. She cheerfully offers to shine customers’ shoes, then sends them on their way pleased with the result.
Lucian Trias is a bread and cheese vendor in Crystalsong Forest who offers goods to browse.
Fialla Sweetberry is a Dalaran food and drink vendor who offers goods to browse.
The Clockwork Assistant is Jepetto’s mechanical companion in Dalaran.

Scout Nisstina, the Three Fingered Bandit, measures a deal by what she can get away with: stolen goods are tempting, but free goods are welcome whatever their origin. She prizes nimble hands and treats a knife as the fallback when theft fails. She has little patience for grand threats, including the Lich King; in her view, powerful figures rise, make a mess, and are eventually brought down by those who follow.
Mechano-hog is a mechanical creature in Crystalsong Forest.

Adamman the Trader is a disgraced former gladiator. He recalls having fame, fortune and top gladiator gear before the Cartel caught him rigging fights and trading wins. He says the scandal cost him everything; now he is left in rags and describes himself as having a bad liver.

npcs.name: Vereesa Windrunner

records.text: Vereesa Windrunner is Ranger General of the Silver Covenant and its leader. The restoration of Quel'Delar is deeply personal to her: she recalls the day Thalorien and Anasterian fell, when the blade was lost, as one of the darkest days of her life. In response to its restoration, she calls the feat remarkable and says the blade is adapting to its bearer.

npcs.title: Ranger General of the Silver Covenant

records.text: Archmage Aethas Sunreaver leads the Sunreavers. In his response to Quel'Delar's restoration, he honors the sin'dorei's recovery from defeat and betrayal but voices surprise that Thalorien Dawnseeker's weapon chose an outsider. He says he cannot explain the choice, credits the bearer with doing what none of his brothers could, and urges them to wield the blade against their common foes.
Archmage Modera is a member of the Kirin Tor.

Shifty Vickers waves off the local contests as no real fighting and promotes Gurgthock and Wodin's new fight club in Zul'Drak, trading on their Ring of Blood reputation from Outland. He directs interested fighters to tell the pair that he sent them.
A Sunreaver scout serving as a ranged combatant.
A Silver Covenant scout serving as a ranged combatant.
Alanura Firecloud is a poisons and reagents merchant in Dalaran, offering visitors goods to browse and buy.
Lanudal Silverhart supplies blacksmithing goods and repairs equipment, serving visitors with practical needs for their gear.
Miura Brightweaver is a named supplier of poisons and reagents.
Felindel Sunhammer supplies blacksmithing goods and offers repairs in Crystalsong Forest.
Marisalira runs a food and drink counter. She casts Fiery Intellect when attacked.
Aniduria supplies food and drink.
Scout Ordimbral serves as a general goods supplier, with ammunition among his wares.
Scout Yribria serves as a general goods supplier, with ammunition among her wares.
Elsia is a scout captain.
Daelin is a scout captain.

The Silver Covenant Horseman is one of several members of the Silver Covenant’s mounted force in this area. In combat, this horseman uses a ranged shot, marking a clear difference from a purely ceremonial or travel role.

The Sunreaver Hawkrider is part of the Sunreavers’ hawkrider force in this area. This combatant uses a ranged shot and can answer an enemy at close range with a concussive shot, giving the role a distinctly active combat function.
Skymaster Baeric serves as a dragonhawk master and flightmaster, offering air travel from this area.
Galendror Whitewing serves as a hippogryph master and flightmaster. When attacked, Galendror calls for guards, showing the danger around the travel service.
A Silver Covenant hippogryph is an animal associated with the Silver Covenant.
A Sunreaver dragonhawk is an animal associated with the Sunreavers.

Rin Duoctane is a quest contact. The available “Luxurious Getaway!” prompt points toward Jeer Sparksocket at K3, whose pitch promises excitement and explosions while warning that manual labor may be required.
Teller Almeida is a banker who offers access to the bank.
Teller Gee is a banker who offers access to the bank.
Paymaster Chang is a banker who offers access to the bank.
Teller Plushner is a banker who provides access to the bank.
Paymaster Amadi is a banker who provides access to the bank.
An elite guard of the Violet Hold.
Archivist Betha is Dalaran’s city historian. She welcomes visitors, reminds them to respect the city’s laws, and offers directions to places such as the arena, auction house, bank, and barber.
An Unbound Trickster attacks with fire blasts and strikes in combat.
An Unbound Dryad attacks with a spear in combat.
Blazik Fireclaw supplies water from his post in Northrend. Visitors can browse his goods through a straightforward vendor service.
Misensi is a cooking-supplies merchant in Northrend.
Derek Odds is a cooking-supplies merchant at a post in Northrend.

Dispirited Ents are woodland creatures encountered in Northrend. In combat they cast Thorns, while at low health they turn to Rejuvenation, showing both a defensive response and a capacity for recovery.

Warden Alturas oversees the Violet Hold during the blue dragon assault on Dalaran. Rhonin directs the player to him discreetly; Alturas provides the prison key and says he and his men will hold the line outside while Lieutenant Sinclari handles access to the prison's defenses. He is pressed for time because the few defenders left inside may not hold, and expects a report once the invasion force has been dealt with.

Officer Van Rossem recruits capable help for the Alliance campaign in Icecrown and arranges passage to the Skybreaker. He presents the airship as the answer to the failed ground assault and speaks confidently about defeating the Horde and Arthas. His role links recruitment with transport to the Icecrown front.

Sky-Reaver Klum is a Horde sky-reaver involved in the Icecrown assault. He recruits able fighters for the campaign against the Alliance and Arthas, and arranges passage to Orgrim's Hammer, the Horde's advanced assault vessel. He praises the ship's readiness and engineering, presenting it as a source of confidence for the attack.
A spirit wolf of Shandaral, capable of using Tendon Rip in combat.

High Warlord Uro is a named Horde leader who rebukes mockery of his battle-garb. He calls the well-worn steel raiment a relic from an ancient place of learning, giving his armor a history beyond its appearance. His brief exchange shows how strongly he values its meaning as well as its condition.
A grove walker defends itself with Thorns and uses Rejuvenation when badly hurt.
An ancient watcher that attacks intruders with Entangling Roots.
A lost spirit associated with Shandaral that attacks with Moonfire in combat.
A Sinewy Wolf is a beast that uses Snarl in combat.
A Dappled Stag is a beast that uses Butt in combat.
Hira Snowdawn is a Cold Weather Flying Trainer. She speaks to Cloudwing, proposes a lap, and says she feels restless or bored.
A Crystal Wyrm is a dragon that uses Frost Breath in combat.
An Azure Manashaper is a humanoid combatant that uses Arcane Blast and Slow.
Azure Scalebane is a dragonkin in Northrend.
Azure Spellweaver is a dragonkin in the Azure Dragonshrine region. It casts Arcane Missiles.
Azure Manabeast is a beast in the Azure Dragonshrine region. It uses Mana Bite.
Archmage Timear is a named archmage in Dalaran. His greeting presents him as a seer, saying he foresees the visitor speaking with Archmage Lan'dalock.

Uda the Beast is an innkeeper who urges visitors to drink, feast, and rest for the next battle, while warning them not to fight and threatening to feed them to her wolves. Inn services and goods are available at her inn.
Arcanist Adurin is Dalaran’s Emblem of Valor quartermaster. Visitors can browse his goods.
Arcanist Ivrenne is Dalaran’s Emblem of Heroism quartermaster. Visitors can browse her goods.
Gnome Diver is a gnome in Dalaran. When it receives a particular emote, it plays an emote in response.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A stabled hunter pet in Crystalsong Forest.
A Smolderweb hatchling in Crystalsong Forest.
A worg pup in Crystalsong Forest.
Zidormi speaks as an individual who can send a visitor to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. Her words describe this as a power she possesses.
A wooly mammoth.
A wooly mammoth.
Nargle Lashcord is a veteran arena vendor. He offers goods and repair services, with the veteran title distinguishing his role among the arena vendors.
Xazi Smolderpipe is an arena vendor who offers goods and repair services.
Zom Bocom is an apprentice arena vendor who offers goods and repair services.
A beast known as Rhukah.
Nargut is a named creature in Northrend.

Arcanist Braedin is a Wintergrasp Battle-Mage associated with a portal for quick travel to the Silver Enclave. His recorded gossip describes battle entry and gives changing preparations as control and battle timing shift, presenting him as a local guide for joining the fighting.

Magister Surdiel is a Wintergrasp Battle-Mage who offers the queue option for the battle. His recorded announcement urges fighters to prepare five minutes before battle, while his gossip explains entry and updates players on battle timing and control.
Harold Winston is identified as a Jewelry Vendor and offers a direct option to browse his goods, giving him a straightforward shopkeeper role.
Mei Francis is an exotic-mount vendor.
The Worg Pup is identified as Nisstina's companion. Its name and creature type establish it as a young animal accompanying someone, rather than a separately characterized speaker.
Shokavis is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Wanathan is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Kyunghee sells throwing axes and offers repairs.
Archmage Alvareaux serves as a Kirin Tor quartermaster in Dalaran. Visitors can browse his goods, marking him out from the arena figures elsewhere in the city.
The Green Warrior is one of the warrior figures associated with Dalaran's sewer arena.
The Gold Warrior is one of the warrior figures associated with Dalaran's sewer arena.
The Green Mage is a mage figure associated with Dalaran's sewer arena, distinct from its warrior figures.
Kanika Goldwell is the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit's Arena Organizer. Her arena menu discusses forming a team, and she offers team charters for ranking matches.
Minzi the Minx is an Arena Battlemaster for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. The battlemaster menu associated with Minzi offers arena participation in the circuit's arena battlegrounds.
Ramik Slamwrench is an Arena Battlemaster for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. The battlemaster menu associated with Ramik offers arena participation in the circuit's arena battlegrounds.
“Dapper” Danik Blackshaft is an Arena Battlemaster for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. The battlemaster menu associated with Danik offers arena participation in the circuit's arena battlegrounds.
Nixi Fireclaw is a water vendor. Nixi's vendor interaction lets visitors browse goods.
An armored snowy gryphon, this creature is identified by its gryphon form and armor.
This armored blue wind rider is one of the mounts associated with Mei Francis in Dalaran.
Christi Stockton is the wine vendor at One More Glass in Dalaran. Her response to a waterlogged recipe calls it a promising find, and she says wine is only as fine as the person drinking it.
Gold Mage is a mage stationed in Dalaran.
Warmage Sarina is a named warmage associated with Violet Stand.
Warmage Halister is a named warmage associated with Violet Stand.
Warmage Ilsudria is one of the warmages stationed at Violet Stand.

Gatekeeper Melindra serves at Violet Stand and is associated with its defense. They cast Frost Armor out of combat and use Fireball and Amplify Damage in combat, a practiced set of protective and offensive spells.
Librarian Belleford is identified by a personal name and the librarian title at Violet Stand.
Warmage Yurias is one of the warmages stationed at Violet Stand. They cast Frost Armor outside combat, indicating a prepared magical combat role.
Sandra Bartan is a barmaid who offers goods for visitors to browse. Her role centers on serving and provisioning guests, with food among the goods associated with her service.
Afsaneh Asrar is an assistant innkeeper who can make the inn a visitor's home. Their innkeeper role centers on welcoming guests and providing lodging.
Mato is a food-and-drink vendor in the local area. Visitors can browse the goods through the vendor service.
Isirami Fairwind is an innkeeper whose greeting offers visitors rest or sustenance. The innkeeper menu includes options to make the inn home and browse goods.
Hamaka is a bartender serving food and drink. Visitors can browse the goods through the vendor service.
Stefen Cotter is a bartender serving food and drink. Visitors can browse the goods through the vendor service.
Abohba is an assistant innkeeper. The innkeeper menu includes an option to make the inn home.
Umbiwa is a barmaid serving food and drink. Visitors can browse the goods through the vendor service.
Mimbihi is a barmaid who offers goods for browsing, with food among her vendor services.
Marcella Bloom is a barmaid who offers goods for browsing, including food.
Laire Brewgold is a brewmaiden who offers goods for browsing, including food.
Galkara is an assassin.
Coira Longrifle is a brewmaiden who offers goods for browsing, including food.
The Underbelly rat is a beast.
Vern is a beast in Crystalsong Forest.
An Underbelly crocodile, this creature belongs to the animal life found in Dalaran's sewer district.
A critter called Badluck in Crystalsong Forest.

A Dalaran resident who sometimes leaves the sanctum for fresh air, this citizen is waiting to meet a woman and wonders if they have the wrong spot. They take comfort that the Lich King's grasp has not reached Dalaran.
A monstrous rat inhabiting Dalaran's Underbelly, this creature is part of the district's sewer wildlife.
A frog found in Dalaran's Underbelly, this animal is part of the life found in the sewer district.
Brammold Deepmine runs an antiques and heirlooms stall in Dalaran, and follows a short walking route with pauses along the way.

Braeg Stoutbeard trades fur and leather in Dalaran.
The Washed-Up Mage is a quest giver in Dalaran. This once-mighty adventurer has a love of kungaloosh and a recipe written on his arm, glimpsed through bars.

A wounded Dalaran shield guard in the Dalaran area of Northrend.
A wounded Dalaran watcher in the Dalaran area of Northrend.
A wounded serpent in the Dalaran area of Northrend.

Emi is a humanoid in Dalaran who follows a route and pauses along the way.
Colin is a humanoid in Dalaran whose routine sends him along a route, where he pauses at the first point.
Babagahnoosh the Grumpy is a humanoid in Dalaran, with an epithet that presents a grumpy persona. He performs an emote out of combat.

Grindle Firespark welcomes travelers to Dalaran and offers help finding places around the city. His shared menu points visitors to services such as the arena, auction house, bank and barber, as well as other destinations.
Whirt the All-Knowing welcomes travelers to Dalaran and offers help finding places around the city. His shared menu points visitors to services such as the arena, auction house, bank and barber.

Grezla the Hag welcomes travelers in Dalaran and offers help finding places around the city. The folkloric title gives this guide a striking public name.
Mona Everspring is a humanoid character with a periodic out-of-combat emote.
Kitz Proudbreeze welcomes travelers to Dalaran and offers help finding places around the city, serving as one of the city's guides.
Crafticus Mindbender welcomes travelers to Dalaran and offers help finding places around the city, serving as one of the city's guides.

Linda Ann Kastinglow is a warmly complimentary Dalaran figure. She calls visitors an inspiration and a fine example, praises them as the finest person she knows, and greets familiar faces with evident enthusiasm.
Archmage Tenaj is an archmage in Dalaran.
Adorean Lew is in Dalaran.
Bitty Frostflinger is in Dalaran.
Magus Fansy Goodbringer is a magus in Dalaran.

Arcanist Alec is a warmly complimentary Dalaran figure. He calls visitors an inspiration and a fine example, praises them as the finest person he knows, and greets familiar faces with evident enthusiasm.

Sabriana Sorrowgaze is a Dalaran guide who greets visitors and offers help finding their way. Her guidance points travelers to the arena, auction house, bank, and barber, and she reminds them to respect Dalaran's laws.
Saedelin Whitedawn is a blood elf in Dalaran who greets visitors with “Anar'alah belore”—a sun-blessing greeting.
Warp-Huntress Kula is a blood elf in Dalaran. Her words are a quiet appreciation of the peace around her: “So peaceful...”
Moon Priestess Nici is a Dalaran priest who offers Elune's blessing to champions.
Sorrow is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Disidra Stormglory is a Dalaran shaman who bids champions well-being.
Great Hexer Ohodo is identified as a Dalaran troll. He greets others warmly: “How you be doin’, mon!”
Violetta is a Dalaran mage who greets a champion with “Good to see you, champion.”

Scribe Whitman is a Dalaran scribe who admires the view. He remarks that Slow Fall would work perfectly if he had brought his light feathers.
Archmage John Nicholas, known as The Punisher, is a named archmage in Dalaran.
Baroness Zildjia is taking in the view from high above, and jokes that light feathers would have made Slow Fall useful there.
Conjurer Weinhaus is taking in the view from high above, and jokes that light feathers would have made Slow Fall useful there.

Bakor the Gangly is an Arena Enthusiast, identified among the arena crowd by his distinctive epithet.
Amera Sky is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Geffon the Unruly is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Mendez Nightshadow is a humanoid in Crystalsong Forest.
Bimble Sparkfingers is an arena enthusiast.
Tuff Gorehoof is an arena enthusiast.
Backbiter is a beast identified by that name.

The Crystalsong Forest Flame Warden welcomes visitors to honor the local festival flame and urges them to honor Alliance fires in other settlements. The warden regards Horde fires as unworthy and encourages their desecration.

The Crystalsong Forest Flame Keeper welcomes visitors to honor the local festival flame and urges them to honor Horde fires in other settlements. The keeper regards Alliance fires as unworthy and encourages their desecration.
Minigob Manabonk is styled as a mischievous mage. His taunt asks whether the listener hates being punked by a gnome.
Tabea is a humanoid. Apollo is identified as Tabea’s companion.
Apollo is identified as Tabea’s companion.
Sarah Brady is an alcohol vendor who offers goods for browsing.
Jessica Sellers is an ink trader who welcomes visitors and offers help finding goods.
Sebastian Bower talks about fishing in the sewer, saying catches can surprise people and relaying shark stories as hearsay.

Lord Everblaze is an elemental found in southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit. His everburning ember is sought in a tale about freeing an icebound maiden who guards an ancient sword.
Fiery Dancers are elemental creatures found in southern Crystalsong Forest.
Unbound Seers are arcane creatures found in the ruins around Crystalsong Forest. In combat, a seer casts Arcane Bolt.

Maloric is the Black Knight's squire. He makes a show of heading into Crystalsong Forest with an axe, claiming to chop wood, but returns with little; he spends time near the ruins southwest of the Mirror of Twilight. Crusader Rhydalla suspects this routine hides something and seeks evidence. Maloric can be incapacitated and searched.
Skeletal Woodcutters are undead found in Crystalsong Forest. Their femurs are sought as a way to distract Maloric, the Black Knight's squire.

Trapjaw Rix is an exceptional arena weaponry merchant at the Argent Tournament grounds. Visitors can browse his goods, and he can repair equipment.
Trapjaw Rix is an exceptional arena weaponry merchant at the Argent Tournament grounds. Visitors can browse his goods, and he can repair equipment.

Jean Pierre Poulain is an Argent Tournament valiant associated with travel to the tournament. His conversation presents participation in the melee as a way to build strength for the strike against the Lich King.
Dubin Clay is a plate armor merchant in Crystalsong Forest. Visitors can browse his goods, and he can repair equipment.
Jones is a noncombat pet named Jones.

Orphan Matron Aria tends Dalaran's orphanage and welcomes returning wards from the Oracle and Wolvar communities. During Children's Week, she invites eligible friends of those groups to care for an orphan, and offers replacement whistles for the sponsored children.
This Isle of Conquest portal is a battleground gateway in Dalaran.
This Isle of Conquest portal is a battleground gateway in Dalaran.

Ghostly Dalaran Celebrants gather to visit with friends and family, celebrating and sharing old stories. Their greeting presents them as returning companions and relatives, brought together in Dalaran for a remembrance or reunion.
A cheerful spirit reunited with friends and family for the holiday, sharing old stories. The feast has left him wanting more Bread of the Dead, and he is grateful for the chance to enjoy it again.

Sorn Proudmane is a warrior with the group holding the front in Northrend. He speaks of a hard fight and sends a battered shield, with well-wishes, to Aponi Brightmane, whose infected wound has taken her back to Thunder Bluff; her smile is missed by those still at the front.
Arcanist Miluria is Dalaran's Emblem of Triumph quartermaster, serving adventurers who come to browse her goods.
Rueben Lauren is a cloth armor merchant and offers armor repair.
Rafael Langrom is a leather armor merchant and offers armor repair.
Horace Hunderland is a plate armor merchant and offers armor repair.
Matilda Brightlink is a mail armor merchant.
Enchanter Isian is an heirloom vendor.

Brassbolt Mechawrench is a steam-powered auctioneer with a haughty, sardonic manner. He claims only grand master engineers have the intellectual capacity to use his superior functions, then pointedly asks why the visitor is still talking to him.

Reginald Arcfire is a steam-powered auctioneer with a haughty, sardonic manner. He claims only grand master engineers have the intellectual capacity to use his superior functions, then pointedly asks why the visitor is still talking to him.
Usuri Brightcoin is a level-75 money changer who offers goods for browsing.
Kaye Toogie is a vendor who offers goods for purchase.

Daros Moonlance, a Highborne researcher, has come from Eldre’Thalas to study the city but says he cannot leave. He asks for help carrying his colleague’s journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus, hoping it will support a diplomatic understanding.

Arcanist Tybalin directs an effort to recover the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from the Sunreavers. Tybalin describes using contacts in the Underbelly to trace their plans, arranges a disguise through Shandy Glossgleam, and sends the recovered book toward Caladis Brightspear in Icecrown. Tybalin’s instructions are urgent: Tybalin fears the Sunreavers will move the information before it can be secured.

Magister Hathorel is a Sunreaver magister in Dalaran, trusted with the recovery of a Wyrmrest tome the Silver Covenant seeks. He is resourceful, drawing on a favor owed by laundryman Shandy Glossgleam, and treats the book’s safe delivery as urgent. His warnings show deep distrust of the Silver Covenant and concern that they will reclaim it.
A Silver Covenant agent in Dalaran, hostile to the Sunreavers and contemptuous of them as lackeys. When confronted, the agent threatens pursuit, reflecting the factions’ active struggle in the city.

A Sunreaver agent in Dalaran who regards the Silver Covenant as thugs trying to drive the Sunreavers from the city. The agent threatens lethal pursuit, showing the hostility between the rival factions.
Aquanos is a named elemental in Dalaran.

Shandy Glossgleam is a Dalaran laundry worker who offers to wash visitors’ clothes for a nominal fee, using his water elemental Aquanos. His brief remarks joke about stains and clean results, giving his practical service a light, matter-of-fact tone.

Apprentice Nelphi is a Kirin Tor apprentice and Lady Jaina Proudmoore’s protégé. In an urgent appeal, Nelphi says Jaina discovered a breach in Icecrown Citadel’s defenses leading to the Forge of Souls and sent word before leaving. Nelphi asks for help finding Jaina there.

Dark Ranger Vorel calls Sylvanas Windrunner “my queen.” Vorel urgently says that Sylvanas has found a breach in Icecrown Citadel’s defenses leading to the Forge of Souls and sent word seeking fierce fighters. Vorel directs the listener to her at the forge entrance.

The Lich King derides an effort to fulfill Mograine's task as predictable and refuses to let it go unopposed. He threatens two people with suffering and eternal unrest, comparing their fate to a father's suffering, then dismisses a foe with a curt wish to die well.
Arcanist Uovril serves as an Emblem of Frost quartermaster in Dalaran, offering goods.
Crown Sprayers are targets in Detective Snap Snagglebolt’s Crystalsong investigation: the assignment directs investigators to the Forlorn Woods to kill them.

Elder Clearwater is an honored fisher who administers the Kalu’ak Fishing Derby in Dalaran. He announces its start and explains that the first person to bring him a blacktip shark will be declared the winner; after the event, he asks anyone with a shark to bring it within the hour.
Frozo the Renowned is a level 75 vendor known as the Frozen Orb Trader. In Northrend, he offers goods for browsing, with his trade centered on frozen orbs.

place_records.text: You are in Crystalsong Forest, a contested land in Northrend where both the Alliance and the Horde hold settlements. The Alliance keeps The Twilight Rivulet and Windrunner's Overlook, and the Horde keeps Forlorn Woods and Sunreaver's Command. Wolves, ents and azure manashapers are the main hostile creatures, and unbound creatures and spirits roam the wilds.

You are in The Twilight Rivulet, an Alliance settlement in Crystalsong Forest with an inn, a bank, a vendor and repairs. Rhonin, leader of the Kirin Tor in Dalaran, wants a reported invasion at the Violet Hold kept quiet. Katherine Lee, a grand master cooking trainer, is among the Alliance folk here, and lost spirits and skeletal woodcutters are hostile nearby.

You are in Forlorn Woods, a Horde settlement in Crystalsong Forest with a flight master, an inn, an auction house and a stable master. Archmage Pentarus has heard nothing from Hemet Nesingwary, who set sail for the Sholazar Basin, so he offers his flying machine to investigators. Grove walkers, sinewy wolves, lost spirits and unbound seers roam the woods.
You are in the Ruins of Shandaral, a ruined corner of Crystalsong Forest. Spirits of Shandaral warriors, druids and hunters haunt it, alongside unbound corrupters, tricksters and ents.
You are in The Azure Front, a stretch of Crystalsong Forest. Azure manashapers, azure scalebanes and crystal wyrms are hostile here, with grove walkers as well.

You are in Violet Stand, a neutral post in Crystalsong Forest where warmages are stationed under a gatekeeper. Archmage Vargoth is under Kael'thas's curse on the Violet Tower and says he will regain his freedom only once the keystone is destroyed. Zidormi claims she can send visitors to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. Azure scalebanes and sinewy wolves are the hostile creatures here.

You are in The Unbound Thicket, a wood of Crystalsong Forest. Unbound ents and dryads, dispirited ents, unbound tricksters and corrupters, and shandaral hunter spirits are hostile here. A Silver Covenant scout of the Alliance is the only friendly person in the wood.

You are in Sunreaver's Command, a Horde settlement in Crystalsong Forest. Skymaster Baeric, a dragonhawk master, offers air travel from here. Felindel Sunhammer sells blacksmithing supplies, and Alanura Firecloud trades in poisons and reagents.

You are in Windrunner's Overlook, an Alliance settlement in Crystalsong Forest. Galendror Whitewing, a hippogryph master, offers air travel from here and calls for guards when attacked. Lanudal Silverhart sells blacksmithing supplies, and Miura Brightweaver trades in poisons and reagents.
